mapper.select: SELECT id, train_no, seat_no, segment_no, remain, update_time FROM stock WHERE instance_no = #{instanceNo} ORDER BY seat_no ASC, segment_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE stock s JOIN stock_capacity c ON c.train_no = s.train_no AND c.seat_no = s.seat_no AND c.segment_no = s.segment_no SET s.remain = s.remain + 1, s.update_time = NOW() WHERE s.instance_no = #{instanceNo} AND s.seat_no = #{seatNo} AND s.segment_no = #{segmentNo} AND s.remain < c.total_capacity
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO stock_restore_record (order_no, seat_no, segment_no) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{seatNo}, #{segmentNo})
mapper.select: SELECT s.instance_no AS instanceNo, s.seat_no AS seatNo, s.segment_no AS segmentNo, s.remain AS remain, c.total_capacity AS capacity FROM stock s JOIN stock_capacity c ON c.train_no = s.train_no AND c.seat_no = s.seat_no AND c.segment_no = s.segment_no WHERE s.remain > c.total_capacity AND s.update_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) LIMIT 200

SELECT x.instanceNo, x.seatNo, x.segmentNo, x.remain, x.expectRemain FROM ( SELECT s.instance_no AS instanceNo, s.seat_no AS seatNo, s.segment_no AS segmentNo, s.remain AS remain, c.total_capacity - ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` o WHERE o.instance_no = s.instance_no AND o.seat_no = s.seat_no AND o.from_seq <= s.segment_no AND o.to_seq > s.segment_no AND o.status IN ('已确认', '已支付') ) AS expectRemain FROM stock s JOIN stock_capacity c ON c.train_no = s.train_no AND c.seat_no = s.seat_no AND c.segment_no = s.segment_no WHERE s.update_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 DAY) ) x WHERE x.remain <> x.expectRemain LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (instance_no, train_no, train_no_v2, seat_no, segment_no, remain, update_time) VALUES (#{instanceNo}, #{trainNo}, #{trainNo}, #{seatNo}, #{segmentNo}, #{remain}, NOW())
